units.solutions: P1 안녕하세요. 하린이에요 (저는 optional). P2 repeat 하린 then 하린 씨예요?→네. S1 direct 민수예요/하린이에요 or repeat same QUESTION 이름이 뭐예요? first. L1 Christian; L2 크리스티안; L3 unchanged. I1 준이에요→partner 유나예요→다시 말해 주세요→유나 씨예요?→네. I2 민수예요. T1 self 하린이에요; partner 민수, confirm 민수 씨예요?; repeat optional if actually needed. Bare name communication versus target ending, alternate natural clarification accepted.
units.review: All main text and separately held facilitator script/key read. Casual-role du explicitly specified, different from universal first-meeting Sie. 준 consonant/민수 vowel types genuinely differ; 씨예요 not substituted as evidence of self-introduction form.

units.solutions: Supported Minsu: 민수는 한국 사람이에요. 영어 해요. Harin chosen name+language: 저는 하린이에요. 한국어 해요; country optional. Formal 무엇입니까 asks name, not language. Script Harin Germany/Korean, Minsu English. New Yuna omitted country; role Jun 저는 준이에요. 한국어 해요. Transfer e.g. 저는 준이에요. 영어 해요 with card-specific truth, listener repeats only disclosed facts.
units.review: DE uses du within peer roleplay, Sie for formal reception example. No real nationality imposed by cards. GRAMMAR_ALLOCATION rows11/12 explicitly receptive; absence of formal production matches individual allocation.

units.solutions: Shelf B bag only: 아니요, 모자가 없어요. 가방이 있어요. Location from speaker A 여기, far B 저기. Script hat near Sujin; checked shelf no bag. New A book/no hat, B hat+bag: 여기 모자가 없어요. 저기 모자가 있어요. 여기 책이 있어요. Extra B-bag question 네, 있어요. Smalltalk found→thanks/not yet→where. Transfer described presence limited to inspected location.
units.review: Here/there viewpoint, absence scope and unknown labels preserved. Required DE collocation/case repair in story line.

units.solutions: Supported umbrella request 우산 주세요→actual handover→감사합니다; action water 물을 마셔요 vs tea 차를 마셔요; chair 여기 앉으세요 and photo 이 사진 보세요. Script tea received, sitting first. New A umbrella; B 수진은 물을 마셔요/크리스티안은 차를 마셔요; C chair/photo invitation. Transfer new taught 휴지 주세요. Smalltalk tea/water/decline all fit.
units.review: DE peer du consistent, action object versus request separated. New 휴지 meaning taught before transfer. Other natural polite requests, e.g. 물 좀 주세요, allowed.

units.solutions: Possession support Christian bag 크리스티안의 가방이에요, Christian role 제 가방이에요. Companion friend+me 친구하고/친구랑 같이 있어요. 과/와 receptive both book+hat. Script book Sujin, bag Christian, companion Hyuna; no claim Hyuna book owner. New Yuna role: ask Jun 준 씨 거예요?; 제 가방이에요; 준은 수진하고/수진이랑 같이 있어요. Unknown owner 잘 모르겠어요. Transfer identify tag then confirm actual owner.
units.review: DE my/your and third-person ownership correct; companion not owner. 과/와 receptive and 의/하고/이랑 productive matches allocation.

units.solutions: Correction wrong bagB→제 가방이 아니에요, request A. Added bag 저도 가방이 있어요. Only umbrella 우산만 주세요. Script Christian owns/keeps hat only; bag returned, water declined. New A own bag/B wrong bag/C own hat: 아니요, 제 가방이 아니에요. 이거 주세요 (A); 저도 모자가 있어요; 차만 주세요. Transfer correct role name then only selected item, e.g. 아니요, 준이에요. 물만 주세요.
units.review: 없어요 absence versus 아니에요 identity/ownership kept separate in DE. Natural shortened 제 거 아니에요 accepted separately from target form. Gate conditions retained; no E04/completion granted.

findings.location: 소개판 앞에서 DE: Sujin hält die Vermutung auf.
findings.problem: A Vermutung cannot idiomatically be halted with aufhalten in this action scene. KO 수진이 막는다 stops Joy from attaching the inferred flag, rather than stopping an abstract supposition.

findings.location: 아직 보지 않은 자리 DE: Hinter das Tuch hat noch niemand gesehen.
findings.problem: The German directional phrase plus sehen is not idiomatic for checking the space behind the cloth. It obscures the concrete uninspected location that motivates the presence task.
findings.proposal: Hinter dem Tuch hat noch niemand nachgesehen.
